newsitem.title: USA: Maine Republican asks King to reconsider tax cap.
newsitem.headline: Maine Republican asks King to reconsider tax cap.

text.p: The chairman of the Maine Republican party is calling on Gov. Angus King to reconsider his opposition to the Republican-backed income tax cap.
Kevin Keough says what working men and women in Maine want is tax relief, not increased government spending.
The Republican pointed that if the governor's proposed budget is adopted, King will have increased state spending by nearly $500 million during his four years in office.
The governor is expected to outline his tax reform plan in his state of the state address early this evening.
